ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central fields on both lobes. High-contrast black contiguous banding along the leading and trailing edges. Dense black pigmentation at the central peduncle attachment point, with a significant vertical linear black streak bisecting the white field on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Lobe boundaries exhibit sharp peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels, particularly pronounced on the inner trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve along the outer margins of both lobes, terminating in narrow, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters concentrated on the distal white regions of both lobes, primarily in the upper quadrants.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical black linear mark on the mid-left lobe; several thin, dark diagonal rake marks visible on the mid-to-lower section of the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical black linear scar on the left lobe white field; irregular notch patterns on the trailing edge consistent with non-uniform tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'comma-shaped' dark pigmentation mark located on the upper-inner boundary of the right lobe's white field.
